利用对称区间上的积分技巧：

设
\[
f(x)=\frac{1}{(1+e^x)(1+x^2)}
\]
则
\[
f(-x)=\frac{1}{(1+e^{-x})(1+x^2)}
=\frac{e^x}{(1+e^x)(1+x^2)}
\]

因此
\[
f(x)+f(-x)
=\frac{1+e^x}{(1+e^x)(1+x^2)}
=\frac{1}{1+x^2}
\]

所以
\[
\int_{-1}^1 f(x)\,dx
=\frac12\int_{-1}^1 \frac{dx}{1+x^2}
=\frac12\left[\arctan x\right]_{-1}^1
\]

\[
=\frac12\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right)
=\frac{\pi}{4}
\]

答案：B
